Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High rate of 401 from PolarSky VPC private endpoints (dedicated pool polarsky-prod-01). Alerting because >= 5% of auth exchanges failing for tenant polarsky. Escalation policy: oncall-sre -> eng-sre.

Alice Nguyen: acked. I'm oncall. hopping in to triage.

Ben Lopez: I see the spike on the auth-proxy metrics: 401s started at ~14:03 UTC, peaked at 14:07. Token validation failures.

Alice Nguyen: Confirming logs show verifier failing to fetch JWKS for issuer https://auth.polarsky.com/.well-known/jwks.json — HTTP 504 from their origin. Sample error from verifier: 

```
2026-03-15T14:05:12Z ERROR verifier: jwks_fetch failed issuer=https://auth.polarsky.com attempt=1 err="upstream timeout: 504 Gateway Timeout"
2026-03-15T14:05:12Z WARN auth: token validation failed tenant=polarsky err="no matching key"
```

Ben Lopez: Their JWKS caching TTL is normally 5m; our fallback keystore hasn't had a fresh key for this issuer since yesterday's rotation, so verification fails when fetch fails.

Maya Kapoor: Paging PolarSky contacts, asking if they rolled a key or rotated certs recently. @emma (PolarSky) can you confirm?

Emma (PolarSky): yes we rotated our signing key at 14:00 UTC and the new JWKS got deployed, but our edge had a config push that caused a short outage and intermittent 504s. We saw retries but origin intermittently returned 504 for ~6 minutes. Sorry, working on stabilizing.

Chris Patel: Thanks. Impact summary for now: any request requiring token validation for polarsky tenant receives 401. This affects their private inference endpoints on dedicated pool polarsky-prod-01 only. Public hosted customers unaffected. Estimated affected requests: ~2.4k in the 5m window.

Dan Rivera: Notifying CS and Solutions. Sending customer-facing note: "We're investigating auth failures, may see 401s for a short window."

Alice Nguyen: Short-term mitigation plan (live):
1) Serve existing cached JWKS (stale) for polarsky for extra grace window while they recover (increase cache TTL and accept keys with last-known kid)
2) If jwks fetch keeps failing, enable temporary issuer bypass for their dedicated pool to accept tokens signed by previously known kid (manual flag)
3) Coordinate with PolarSky to confirm JWKS is healthy before rollback.

Ben Lopez: I'm going to extend local JWKS cache TTL to 1h and set fallback to accept last-known KID for 10m. Rolling a config change to polarsky prod pool.

Infra Deploy Bot: :rocket: Starting config rollout to cluster polarsky-prod-01 by user Ben Lopez. Change: auth.proxy.jwks.cache_ttl=3600s, auth.proxy.jwks.accept_stale_kid=600s.

Alice Nguyen: Putting a short safety guard: will monitor error rate, and if 5xx backend errors rise, we will rollback.

Chris Solutions: Is there any tenant isolation risk if we relax verification? Need to ensure no cross-tenant key acceptance.

Alice Nguyen: Good call. The change only affects issuer=https://auth.polarsky.com and tenant id mapping polarsky; no wildcard acceptance. Documented in rollout.

Infra Deploy Bot: :white_check_mark: Rollout completed to polarsky-prod-01 (3/3 nodes) by Ben Lopez at 14:12 UTC.

Ben Lopez: Observability: 401 rate dropped from 18% -> 1.1% over next 90s after rollout. KC metric auth.token.failures[polarsky] down to baseline.

Alice Nguyen: Notifying customer success and the PolarSky ops contact we applied a temporary cache grace window. @Emma (PolarSky) please confirm your jwks endpoint is fully healthy and serving the new key.

Emma (PolarSky): jwks now healthy and serving 200 for all checks since 14:15 UTC. We did a small retry bump on edge and cleared a routing table glitch.

Alice Nguyen: Ok, plan for recovery: keep the cache grace window for 10 minutes to avoid flapping, then revert to normal TTL and disable accept_stale_kid after we confirm no further 5xx/504s. We'll coordinate final rollback and send a post-incident summary.

Ben Lopez: Will schedule the revert at 14:26 UTC unless we see new errors.

Oncall-SRE: Handing off to next oncall for follow-up (Ben will remain as owner for postmortem). Next oncall: Maya Kapoor.

Maya Kapoor: acked. I'll monitor for 30m and then start RCA with SRE + Solutions.

Alice Nguyen: Customer impact note for internal log:
- Customer: PolarSky (enterprise, VPC/dedicated pool)
- Impact: token validation failures causing 401s on private endpoints for ~12 minutes (14:03–14:15)
- Root cause (initial): PolarSky key rotation coincided with an edge config push that caused intermittent 504s from their jwks origin, preventing our verifier from refreshing keys.
- Mitigation: temporary JWKS cache TTL increase and accept_stale_kid for 10m.
- Status: Resolved, customer JWKS healthy, auth failures returned to baseline.

Dan Rivera: CS will prepare a customer-facing incident note and schedule a post-incident call if requested.

Chris Solutions: Action items (owners):
- SRE: formalize an automatic fallback that prefers last-known KIDs for 2m when fetch fails (Ben)
- Infra: add circuit-breaker metrics for jwks fetch latency per-issuer (Alice)
- Solutions: update onboarding docs for customers rotating keys (Chris Solutions)
- CS: notify PolarSky and offer a postmortem meeting (Dan)

Alice Nguyen: Tagging for postmortem: severity: customer-impacting, sla risk: minor. Starting timeline capture window.

Incident Bot: Incident incident-2026-03-15-polarsky-auth created, severity=high-customer, incident_owner=Ben Lopez, incident_channel=#incidents. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/incident-2026-03-15-polarsky-auth

Ben Lopez: I'll own the follow-up and add timeline + config diffs. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Emma (PolarSky): Thanks for the quick response, appreciate the temporary measure. We'll follow up with our infra change notes and postmortem.

Alice Nguyen: Handoff complete. Closing thread for live mitigation; keep any new observations in the incident channel thread.

[post-thread notes] Alice Nguyen: add to postmortem: consider offering a small recommended window for JWKS propagation in onboarding docs, and add a test probe for customer jwks endpoints during onboarding.

[END OF THREAD]
